item.title: Roofing work - articles being thrown into street, 10th August
item.description:
Roofing contractors are carrying out work. Scaffolding occupies the pavement. Roofing felt/material was being thrown from the roof directly onto the public road below, apparently without a banksman or anyone controlling pedestrians/traffic. I witnessed the material being thrown - while pedestrians were potentially able to pass through the area. Please could the highway authority check whether there are arrangements for protecting pedestrians and road users (and scaffolding has the necessary highway permission).

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 6, Charles Street, Wymans Brook, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
